title: Incorrect early return
detail: The code returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict when a cookie string is provided, skipping the parsing logic. This causes all valid cookies to be ignored.
note: Says a present cookie returns an empty dict, which the planted `if cookie:` does.

title: Incorrect file pointer check
detail: The condition now skips processing any non‑None file pointer, causing all files to be ignored. The original code intended to skip only when fp is None.
note: Says set file values are skipped, which the planted `is not None` does.
